# WE7 · Bác sĩ & phòng · không có khoảng khóa

Group **WE · Ảnh, bác sĩ & phòng, dịch vụ** · state · Next.js: **planned (U4)** (`/resources`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/operations-ui.js#resources`
- Studio is `clinic.js › studio()/photos()`; resources and services are `operations-ui.js › resources()/services()` with the dialogs `block` and `service`.
- `operations-ui.js › resources()` after "Gỡ khóa" (`data-ops="unblock"`, handled in `handle()`): the block list is filtered and the page re-rendered at once, with no confirmation and no toast. The only demo block (B1, 2026-09-21, 14:00–15:00, "Bảo trì thiết bị laser") disappears.
- With `o.blocks` empty the table body is one row: `<tr><td colspan="5">Không có khoảng khóa.</td></tr>`. The table head (Phòng, Ngày, Thời gian, Lý do, empty last column), the "Khóa phòng" button and the doctor cards stay.
- Inventory note: After "Gỡ khóa" of the only demo block the table shows "Không có khoảng khóa."
- Page key `resources` is allowed for roles: owner (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"resources\"]"} → {"click":"[data-ops=\"unblock\"]"} → {"wait":".table"}; it must show "Không có khoảng khóa.".

## Differences from the app design
- App F14 has no table of blocks: it lists the four doctors as tiles and one notice line ("Laser & thủ thuật · Bảo trì 14:00–15:00 ngày 23/09. Khóa phòng phức tạp duyệt ở web."). The web table, its "Gỡ khóa" button and the empty row text exist only on the web.

## Gotchas
- The empty row is plain table text, not an `.empty` block: draw it as an empty row of the table shell, the same way WF25 and WG11 do.
- Unlike `block()` (which asserts the `config` capability), the unblock branch of `handle()` has no assert of its own.
